name: 08876 · Somerville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08876 (Somerville) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08876 (Somerville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08876 (Somerville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
